USO_UNSAFE_ACCESSIBLE_OBJECT_SYNCHRONIZA.reason: MediaCluster synchronizes the internally created Session to serialize closure and ownership deletion. References are used only by trusted in-process Java code; no caller-supplied monitor or plugin object enters the model. RPC ownership is independently fenced.
USO_UNSAFE_ACCESSIBLE_OBJECT_SYNCHRONIZA.evidence: Exact reported method/source reviewed; regression evidence in ServicesTest, VoiceTest, GatewayLifecycleTest, MediaTest, LegacyLedgerTest and HttpBoundaryTest where applicable. Deployment transport conditions remain separately unverified.

USO_UNSAFE_INHERITABLE_OBJECT_SYNCHRONIZ.reason: Owner map is a final internally constructed ConcurrentHashMap, not supplied by a request or subclass. create serializes admission/journal intent; only package-private trusted controller code reads ownership. No untrusted Java extension boundary is exposed.
USO_UNSAFE_INHERITABLE_OBJECT_SYNCHRONIZ.evidence: Exact reported method/source reviewed; regression evidence in ServicesTest, VoiceTest, GatewayLifecycleTest, MediaTest, LegacyLedgerTest and HttpBoundaryTest where applicable. Deployment transport conditions remain separately unverified.

UNSAFE_HASH_EQUALS:com/duozhi/services/N.reason: Equality compares public request/text SHA-256 values for idempotency conflict detection, not authentication secrets. Bearer/HMAC checks use MessageDigest.isEqual via Support.equals. A timing observation cannot recover a secret from these payload fingerprints.
UNSAFE_HASH_EQUALS:com/duozhi/services/N.evidence: Exact reported method/source reviewed; regression evidence in ServicesTest, VoiceTest, GatewayLifecycleTest, MediaTest, LegacyLedgerTest and HttpBoundaryTest where applicable. Deployment transport conditions remain separately unverified.

USO_UNSAFE_OBJECT_SYNCHRONIZATION:com/du.reason: NativeMedia serializes writes to a trusted Spring WebSocketSession created by the server framework.
